title: Media God Mobile
message: Media God Mobile 1.0.65 fixes a mobile-only native handoff failure that could occur on titles with hundreds of Real-Debrid/torrent sources. The Android player now receives only the active source metadata, and the APK defensively compacts any oversized hosted payload before crossing the Activity/Binder boundary. This targets the Base44-works/mobile-fails pattern and Saw/Saw X crashes. Live TV is unchanged.
